# Crank Nation Studios

Recording studio in Beltsville, MD, at 4600 Powder Mill Rd. Phone +1-301-955-6914.
Founded by producer Mic Kartel. Genres: Hip Hop, R&B, Soul, Pop, Reggae.

## Booking
Book at https://bookit-crank-nation.pages.dev/ — pick what you need, pick hours or songs,
pick a day and start time, add contact details, see the full price before confirming.
FAQ: https://bookit-crank-nation.pages.dev/faq.html

## Rates (published pricing, confirm current rates with the studio)
- Recording studio time: $60 per hour, mixing and mastering included
- Mixing: $80 per song
- Mastering: $50 per song
- Mix + Master: $130 per song
- Exclusive beat: $200 per beat

## Demo status
This is a Tier 0 demo booking site. Demo bookings are saved nowhere, emailed nowhere,
and texted nowhere. The downloadable session sheet is the only record.
